```{r Build spatial basis functions}
#Fitting GLM
bfs <- make_basis(k = 50, domain, from.package = "scampr")

# need to prune in the case of scampr bfs
if (is(bfs, "scampr.bf")) {
  tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, rbind(pres[, c("x", "y")], quad[,c("x", "y")]))
#  tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, pres[,c("x", "y")]) # via the data?
  bf.check <- apply(tmp, 2, function(x){sum(x > 0)})
  bfs <- bfs[bf.check != 0, ]
  rm(tmp, bf.check)
}

#evaluate basis functions at every data point
Z_star = bf_matrix(bfs, dat[, c("x", "y")])
#Z_star = Z_star/max(apply(Z_star,2,sd)) #some standardisation needed for ridge fits
```

```{r glm with loop to convergence}
set.seed(0)
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))

attach(dat_rename)
Zu = Z_star%*%u
X_full = cbind(1, mi, tempann)
beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(Zu) + ncol(X_full)) 

N = 1000 
loglik = -Inf
max_it = 3

for (iter in 1:N){
  X_Zu = cbind(X_full, Zu)
 
  if (iter == 1) {
    start_iter = NULL
  } else {
    start_iter = as.numeric(beta_lambda)
  }
  
  glm1 = glm.fit(y = occ/wt, x = X_Zu, intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = wt, start = start_iter, control = glm.control(maxit = max_it))
  
  # store this species' intercept + beta + lambda
  beta_lambda = t(c(glm1$coefficients)) 
  
  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)]
  lambda = (beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)])
  
  #fixed-effect linear predictor
  offset_matrix = X_full%*%(beta)
  
  Zl_joint = Z_star*lambda 
#  attr(Zl_joint, "xm") = rep(0, ncol(Zl_joint))
#  attr(Zl_joint, "xs") = rep(1, ncol(Zl_joint))
  
  #fit shared u via one joint ridge regression
  glm1 = glm.fit(x = Zl_joint, y = occ/wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = wt, offset = as.numeric(offset_matrix), start = as.numeric(u), control = glm.control(maxit = max_it))
  
  new_u = as.numeric(glm1$coefficients)
    
  u = new_u
  print(u)
  
  # Rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  Zu = Z_star%*%u
  
  eta = offset_matrix + rowSums(Zu * lambda)
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_glm = mu
  
  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_glm = sum(occ * log(mu) - wt *mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_glm, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if(abs((loglik_new_glm - loglik)/loglik_new_glm) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_glm}

save(loglik_new_glm, file = "loglik_new_glm.RDATA")
```

```{r penalised glm with loop to convergence, Zulambda}
#Fitting penalised glm
library(glmnet)
ridgePen=0.1 #penalty strength
set.seed(0)

#initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))

attach(dat_rename)
Zu = Z_star%*%u
X_full = cbind(1, mi, tempann) #10426 x 4, fixed-effect design matrix
X_Zu = cbind(X_full[, -1], Zu)

beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(Zu) + ncol(X_full)) #fitted intercept+beta+lambda per species

N = 1000 #max no. of outer (column-update + row-update) iterations
loglik = -Inf
max_it = 3 #max iterations glmnet allowed

warm_start = if (all(is.finite(beta_lambda))) {
  list(a0 = glmnet1$a0, beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
} else {
  NULL
}
penalty_factor = c(rep(0, ncol(X_full) - 1), rep(1, ncol(Zu))) 

for (iter in 1:N){
    #design matrix - covariates + species' rows of spatial term (Zu)
  X_Zu = cbind(X_full[, -1], Zu)
    
    #weighted Poisson ridge regression - DWPR response (pt/wt), weight = wt
    glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = occ/wt, x = as.matrix(X_Zu), intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), warm = warm_start, weights = wt, alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, penalty.factor = penalty_factor, control = glmnet.control(mxitnr = max_it))
    
    # store this species' intercept + beta (3 covariates) + lambda (1 loading)
    beta_lambda = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) 
  
  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)] #1 x 4
  lambda = (beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)]) #1 x 1
  
    #row update: fit one shared spatial field (u)
  #elementwise product: each basis function scaled by that row's species' loading

  #fixed-effect linear predictor
  offset_matrix = X_full%*%beta #10426 x 1
    
  Zl_joint = Z_star * lambda #10426 x 1
  attr(Zl_joint, "xm") = rep(0, ncol(Zl_joint))
  attr(Zl_joint, "xs") = rep(1, ncol(Zl_joint))
  
  #fit shared u via one joint ridge regression
  glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(x = Zl_joint, y = occ/wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = wt, offset = as.numeric(offset_matrix), alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, warm = list(a0 = 0, beta = as.numeric(u)), control = glmnet.control(mxitnr = max_it)) 
  
  new_u = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta)
    
  u = new_u #43 x 1, updated shared spatial field coefficients
  print(u)
  
  #rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  Zu = Z_star%*%u
  
  #convergence check - weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood kernel + Gaussian prior on u --- ##
  eta = offset_matrix + rowSums(Zu * lambda)
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_glmnet = mu

  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_glmnet = sum(occ * log(mu) - wt * mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_glmnet, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if(abs((loglik_new_glmnet - loglik)/loglik_new_glmnet) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_glmnet}

save(loglik_new_glmnet, file = "loglik_new_glmnet.RDATA")
```
